verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs documents a first-party keyterm capability that lets users select up to 1000 specific words or sentences so Scribe transcribes them accurately in context. This directly covers boosting domain terms, names, and jargon. missing for 10: API-reference documentation of the parameter for developers, evidence of whether it works in realtime/WebSocket mode, and independent or hands-on corroboration that boosted terms actually improve accuracy.
